statement.detailedDescription: The cardholder's Mastercard expired [2 months before this transaction]. A replacement card with a new number was issued and the expired card was destroyed. A $385.00 charge from 'BRILLIANCE JEWELERS' was processed using the expired card number via magnetic stripe. The cardholder did not visit this store or make this purchase.
statement.merchantResponseSummary: N/A — card was expired and destroyed; cardholder has no knowledge of this transaction.
statement.requestedResolution: Full reversal. The card used was expired and no longer valid.
statement.cardholderDeclaration: I declare that the information provided in this dispute statement is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge and belief.

bankInternalNotes.recommendedAction: Proceed with chargeback filing under Mastercard reason code 4835 (Card Not Valid or Expired).
